about.title: About
about.metaDescription: What Coachlore is: a fan-made Pokédex and a home for Pokémon draft leagues, and the sources it credits.
about.intro: Coachlore is a fast, mobile-first Pokédex and a home for Pokémon draft leagues, from the live draft to the final standings.
about.leagues: Friends draft Pokémon with a points budget, then play a season of matches on Pokémon Showdown. Coachlore keeps the score: the draft, the schedule, trades, standings and stats.
about.made: A personal, non-commercial project. Its code is open to read.
about.credits: The Pokémon data comes from PokéAPI and Pokémon Showdown, and usage statistics from Smogon. Their licences are on the legal page.

legal.title: Legal
legal.metaDescription: Coachlore’s not-affiliated notice, the licences of the data and images it uses, and how it handles your data.
legal.notice: Coachlore is an independent, unofficial, non-commercial fan project, not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Nintendo, Creatures, Game Freak or The Pokémon Company. Pokémon and Pokémon character names are trademarks of Nintendo, Creatures and Game Freak; Pokémon images and names © Nintendo, Creatures, Game Freak and The Pokémon Company.

licences.showdown: Battle data and formats. MIT licence.
licences.sprites: Sprites and artwork © The Pokémon Company, shown as few as possible.

legal.privacy: Reading Coachlore needs no account. Your language is remembered in a cookie on this browser, and your theme and shortcut settings in its storage. Error reports carry no IP address, cookies, account or page address. The full privacy notice arrives before the first league starts.
